releaseTitle: v1.5.1 - Screen Capture Timeout Fix & Universal Left-Side Message Capture
releaseNotes:
• Fixed 'Screen capture timed out waiting for frame' by caching the latest VirtualDisplay frame for static chat screens
• Fixed wide left-aligned received messages (with or without profile avatars) across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Tinder, Bumble & Hinge
• Cancellable frame capture watchdogs prevent stale timeout errors
